info.name: FitCloud API
info.description: Run the folders in order (1 to 8) or use the Collection Runner. Register saves the token automatically.

formdata.description: Optional: tick this and choose a JPG/PNG/WEBP (max 2 MB). Needs AWS S3 configured.

exec: pm.test('Returns token and user without password', function () { pm.expect(j.data.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.data.user).to.not.have.property('password'); });

body.raw:
{
  "planName": "Morning Run",
  "description": "5 km easy run",
  "type": "Cardio",
  "duration": 30,
  "goal": "Improve stamina",
  "status": "Not Started",
  "progress": 0,
  "date": "{{today}}"
}

exec: pm.test('Status became In Progress', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('In Progress'); });

item.name: Invalid data (empty plan name, negative duration)

exec: pm.test('Friendly message', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'); });
